text:
Julie (Events): Quick sync — we need to lock the plan for the London evening satellite: booth, speaker slot confirmations, swag, and how we route leads from the afterparty sign-up sheet. Deadline: EOD Tuesday.
Sam G (Growth): Got it. Can confirm lead routing: evening sign-ups should go to a dedicated HubSpot form (utm=ldn-evening). Will we capture email + company + interest area?
Julie (Events): Yes — email, company, interest area (embed: 'integration / cost / eval'). Keep it short for mobile.
Miguel (Design): I'll make the QR + landing hero. Any brand dos/don'ts for the flyer?
Tara (Content): Use the new product blurb (two lines) "Redwood: predictable LLM inference at scale" + CTA "Request demo & benchmark". I'll draft microcopy for the landing page.
Adrian (Ops): Booth tech checklist: 1 x demo laptop (intel NUC backup), 1x 4G hotspot (backup), HDMI cable, power strip, extension, surge protector. Also need a small table for live demo and a sign for the talk schedule.
Loren (Logistics): Swag vendor quoted. Need final counts. Proposal: 350 stickers, 150 tees (S-XL split below), 120 reusable water bottles, 80 enamel pins, 40 tote bags. ETA for print: 12 business days if we approve by Friday.
Sam G (Growth): For lead nurturing, propose sequence: Day 0: immediate email + calendar link. Day 3: benchmark whitepaper. Day 10: invite to hosted webinar. I'll hook this up to flow builder.
Julie (Events): Tee size split — let's be conservative: S:20, M:60, L:45, XL:20, XXL:5. Any objections?
Miguel (Design): XXL logo needs slight scale tweak. I'll export print-ready files today.
Tara (Content): Also drafting a 30s demo script for the speaker slot — focus on latency + cost demo, show a 2-query comparison vs unoptimized. Will post script for review.
Loren (Logistics): Shipping address for vendor: 
```
Redwood Inference — Events
Attn: Loren / Julie
Unit 4, Shoreline Studios
12 Dockside Walk
London, E16 2BX
```
Loren (Logistics): Vendor requires a PO by Thursday. I can issue from procurement once counts confirmed.
Adrian (Ops): Booth network: we'll request venue wired ethernet. If they can't, hotspot + local caching for demo. Need static demo model pinned (r-3b-quant) to avoid cold starts. Add model pin to deployment config: `model: r-3b-quant@v2`
Sam G (Growth): For speakers: who is confirmed? I have Julie (Events) and Miguel tentative for a short case study. We should submit final speaker bios to the conference org by Wednesday.
Julie (Events): Confirmed: Julie (Events) leading 10 min lightning + Q&A. Miguel will do short product visuals if he can make it. Tara please finalize bios (2-3 lines each).
Tara (Content): Draft bios posted here: "Julie: Head of Events, Redwood — runs infra/partner programs" and "Miguel: Product Designer, Redwood — builds UX for inference observability". Please edit.
Shippo Bot: Shipment created: ORDER#RDW-2026-559, ETA 2026-05-14, tracking: https://shippo.example/track/RDW-2026-559
Loren (Logistics): Shippo confirms vendor pick-up in 2 business days if we approve proof.
Sam G (Growth): Lead routing detail: QR -> landing (utm=ldn-evening) -> HubSpot form -> tag "ldn-evening-2026" -> flow. I will also add Meetup CSV import if sign-ups come from the event app.
Julie (Events): Action list: Miguel export print files (today), Tara finalize bios + landing copy (tomorrow), Sam finalize HubSpot form + nurture flow (tomorrow), Loren approve PO + schedule pickup (by Thu), Adrian pin demo model + prepare hotspot (by Thu). I'll consolidate and send calendar invite for walk-through on Thursday 10am BST. :spiral_calendar:
Sam G (Growth): One more ask — badge scanner? If we use QR and HubSpot form we can avoid badge scanner. Simpler.
Miguel (Design): I'll upload final QR variations (color + b/w) to the assets folder and include a version for print and a version for digital only.
Tara (Content): I'll draft the in-email subject lines for the immediate follow-up: "Great meeting you at the Redwood evening — demo & benchmark" and a short preview.
Julie (Events): Great. If anyone can't hit the deadlines, ping me asap. Thanks all :tada:
